Occurrences.Kwic: 四照用師一日示眾云。我有時先照後用。有時先用後照。有時照用同時。有時照用不同時。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (T/T48/T48n2006.xml). Eyes of Humans and Devas (人天眼目): the source compiler supplies the editorial heading Four Modes of Illumination and Function. The following formal address gives the fourfold definition separately; Linji Yixuan is the contextual section master.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: 四照用 is an editorial heading. The following 師一日示眾 introduces the section master’s separate fourfold statement; Huiyan Zhizhao compiles the work but is not the headword actor.

Occurrences.Kwic: 三玄、三要、四料揀、四賓主、四照用，已是臨濟老人吐下底殘羹餿飯。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J26/J26nB182.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Wanru (萬如禪師語錄): Wanru Tongwei is the exact headword speaker. Wanru Tongwei: lists the Four Modes of Illumination and Function among Linji's numbered devices and calls them leftover food.

Occurrences.Kwic: 頌四照用曰：有時先照後用，舉似諸方傳誦，拋出無孔鐵鎚，莫怪山僧手重。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X82/X82n1571.xml). Complete Five Lamps (Vols. 34–120) (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)): Cheng Zhengkui is the exact headword speaker. gives a verse explicitly headed on the Four Modes of Illumination and Function; the governing source heading identifies him as the Grand Minister Cheng Zhengkui, style Duanbo.

ActorAttribution.GrammarEvidence: X/X82/X82n1571.xml 0509b07 explicitly heads 大司空程正揆端伯居士. His verse is an utterance by a named layman, not a master link.

Occurrences.Kwic: 四照用。照時劈箭，好醜俱現。纖芥不藏，日面月面。手握金輪，用處無情。三頭六臂，落膽喪魂。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (J/J38/J38nB414.xml). Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Zhenzai of Shanduo (山鐸真在禪師語錄): Shanduo Zhenzai is the exact headword speaker. Shanduo Zhenzai: gives a new verse under the exact Four Modes label.

SearchAliases: Four Modes of Illumination and Function
Senses.Explanation: The four illumination-and-function combinations are illumination before function, function before illumination, both at once, and neither at the same time; later records redeploy the fourfold definition in interviews and verse. The selected exact turns and their attributed speakers or narrators bound this account; the entry does not add a resolution beyond those deployments.
